selection: actual forecast accuracy on authenticated fixed panels; never latent loss or Gaussianity
verified_source_findings: Epps-Pulley formula matches local LeJEPA reference; batch N multiplier intentional
reference uses separate nonlinear target projector; temporal implementation regularizes affine forecast-input embedding
416-dimensional patch input includes identically zero endpoint close; affine 512-dimensional isotropic ideal is unattainable in exact arithmetic
temporal targets contain exogenous history and future-endpoint-centered patch shape rather than fixed source-to-future price outcomes

diagnosis.population: authenticated 2048 validation origins at common source after all training targets
diagnosis.gradient_cohort: first deterministic 256 validation rows at that same source; no parameter updates
measurements: same-mask target/prediction covariance and centered MSE identity
population covariance participation rank and leading share
SIGReg relative to finite-population Gaussian null
weighted patch gradients and forecast/close-error alignment

placement_experiment.change: disposable pointwise D512-GELU-D512 target projector, raw observation remains forecast input, attached targets
placement_experiment.interpretation: compare within-pair SIGReg effect with original anchored/no-SIGReg; common improvement is projector architecture, not proof SIGReg helps

temporal_candidate_gate: Choose from source semantics plus frozen diagnosis, not from an arbitrary Gaussianization/weight sweep. Predict fixed task-relevant conditional moments if movable nuisance targets/gradient conflict are supported; do not force conditional means or innovations to unit Gaussian variance.
decision: Retain best measured forecast-only baseline unless a candidate improves predefined aggregate close accuracy without concealing horizon, directional or calibration tradeoffs. Single-seed development evidence is not optimality proof, profitability or terminal-test validation.
